prompt: I want to travel from Stillwater to the ruined fortress of Deepcrag, which is three days north across haunted marshland. How do we begin?

assertions.description: Response includes a create_progress_track tool call with kind=journey
A journey rank (troublesome/dangerous/formidable/extreme/epic) is explicitly chosen before or during the tool call
The GM does not roll Undertake a Journey on the player's behalf — departure is narrated and the roll is left to the player
